name: Derivation Walkthrough
description: Builds a result step by step: the assumptions, the starting law, each algebraic step with its reason, the result, when it applies, and a check.
audience: Physics and maths derivations and proofs, Class 11 onwards.

signals.why: your words ask for a derivation or proof
